NAC Breda, often simply known as NAC, is a Dutch professional football club, based in Breda, Netherlands. NAC Breda play in the Rat Verlegh Stadium, named after their most important player, Antoon 'Rat' Verlegh. The club competes in the Eerste Divisie, the second tier of Dutch football, following relegation from the Eredivisie in the 2025–26 season. In their history, NAC won one national title in 1921 and won one KNVB Cup in 1973.
